request.query: fetch instagram reel analytics performance metrics

results.use_case: fetch instagram reel analytics performance metrics
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if account context is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm accessible professional context using INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO (ensure insights are available for the authenticated professional account).

[Required (if ig_media_id is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Locate the target post using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA (request minimal fields; match by stable returned identifiers such as id/permalink-like fields).
[Optional (if target not in first page)] [Step]: Paginate INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA using response.data.paging.cursors.after until found or no cursor remains.
[Optional (if media type/eligibility is unclear)] [Prerequisite]: Validate the selected item using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA (confirm it exists and check minimal type/product fields).
[Required] [Step]: Fetch per-media metrics using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_INSIGHTS (pass metric as an array; normalize response.data.data[*] into name→value via values[0].value, sometimes item.value).

[Fallback (if insights are empty/partial or error)] [Fallback]: Retry INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_INSIGHTS once with a reduced, known-valid metric list; keep partial results and optionally re-check the id using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA.
[Optional (if carousel child ids are needed)] [Next Step]: Expand children using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_CHILDREN (report child ids; analytics typically remain at the parent).
[Optional (if qualitative engagement is needed)] [Next Step]: Fetch comments using INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_COMMENTS (empty data can be valid; paginate only when paging is present).
known_pitfalls: [INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA] Passing a non-numeric or inaccessible ig_media_id can fail with API error code 100 (unsupported request).
[INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO] Auth issues can surface as 401 with error code 190, blocking downstream id resolution.
[INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA] response.data.paging.next may be a full next-page URL with sensitive query data—paginate via response.data.paging.cursors.after.
[INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_INSIGHTS] Metric eligibility/format is strict; incompatible metrics or non-array metric values often yield HTTP 400 or empty results.
[INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_INSIGHTS] Transient HTTP 500 (OAuthException code 2) can occur; retry later/backoff and preserve partial outputs instead of re-mapping ids immediately.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Flatten INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_INSIGHTS into {metric_name: value} handling values[0].value and occasional item.value.
Extract media rows and the next cursor from an INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA response.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
def extract_media_page(resp):
    d=(resp or {}).get('data') or {}
    rows=d.get('data') or []
    after=((d.get('paging') or {}).get('cursors') or {}).get('after')
    return [{'id':r.get('id'),'permalink':r.get('permalink'),'created_time':r.get('timestamp')} for r in rows], after
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Instagram is a social media platform for sharing photos, videos, and stories. Only supports Instagram Business and Creator accounts, not Instagram Personal accounts.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=instagram. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="instagram") to create a connection BEFORE executing any instagram tools.

INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_INSIGHTS.description: Tool to get insights and metrics for Instagram media objects (photos, videos, reels, carousel albums). Use when you need to retrieve performance data such as views, reach, likes, comments, saves, and shares for specific media. Note: Insights data is only available for media published within the last 2 years, and the account must have at least 1,000 followers. Requires a Business or Creator account; personal Instagram profiles are not supported.

metric.description: List of metrics to retrieve. Must be provided as an array of strings, e.g., ['reach', 'saved', 'likes']. COMMONLY SUPPORTED METRICS: views, reach, saved, likes, comments, shares, total_interactions, reposts. REELS-SPECIFIC METRICS: ig_reels_video_view_total_time, ig_reels_avg_watch_time, reels_skip_rate, facebook_views, crossposted_views. FEED-AND-STORY METRICS: profile_activity. STORIES-SPECIFIC METRICS: link_clicks, replies, navigation, follows, profile_visits. DEPRECATED METRICS (will be filtered out): 'impressions', 'plays', 'video_views', 'clips_replays_count', 'ig_reels_aggregated_all_plays_count' (use 'views' instead); 'taps_forward', 'taps_back', 'exits' (Story navigation metrics deprecated in API v18+, use 'navigation' instead). INVALID METRIC NAMES (will be rejected): 'clicks', 'engagement' are NOT valid metric names.

period.description: The time period for metric aggregation. Instagram media insights automatically use 'lifetime'; other period values are not supported.

breakdown.description: Optional breakdown dimension for supported metrics. Allowed values: 'action_type' (e.g. for profile_activity) and 'story_navigation_action_type' (for Story navigation). Only applicable to metrics that support breakdowns.

ig_media_id.description: The ID of the Instagram media object (photo, video, reel, carousel album) for which to retrieve insights

graph_api_version.description: Instagram Graph API version to use

INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA.description: Get Instagram user's media collection (posts, photos, videos, reels, carousels). Use when you need to retrieve all media published by an Instagram Business or Creator account with support for pagination and time-based filtering.

after.description: Cursor for forward pagination - retrieve media after this cursor Value comes from paging.cursors.after in the response; stopping at the first page silently omits older posts.

limit.description: Number of media items to return per page (default: 25, max: 100)

since.description: Unix timestamp - filter results to media created after this time. If both 'since' and 'until' are provided, 'since' must be less than 'until'.

until.description: Unix timestamp - filter results to media created before this time. If both 'since' and 'until' are provided, 'since' must be less than 'until'.

before.description: Cursor for backward pagination - retrieve media before this cursor

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Available fields: id, caption, media_type, media_url, permalink, thumbnail_url, timestamp, username, comments_count, like_count, legacy_instagram_media_id, is_comment_enabled, owner, shortcode, media_product_type, alt_text, is_ai_generated, is_shared_to_feed, media_audio_type, view_count, reposts_count, saved_count, shares_count, total_like_count, total_comments_count, total_views_count, children{media_url,media_type,thumbnail_url} Reels appear as media_type=VIDEO and media_product_type=REELS; filter both fields to identify reels. media_url is a direct file URL; permalink is the user-facing share link. Optional fields like caption and like_count may be null or absent in the response.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator Account ID. Use 'me' for the authenticated user, or provide the numeric IG User ID obtained from the Instagram Graph API (typically 17 digits, e.g., '17841405793187218'). Facebook Page IDs are not supported or automatically converted.

graph_api_version.description: Instagram Graph API version to use (e.g., 'v21.0')

auto_resolve_fb_page_id.description: Deprecated no-op retained for backwards compatibility. On Instagram Login the host follows the token (graph.instagram.com) and Facebook Page IDs are not resolved. Provide an Instagram Business or Creator Account ID directly (or 'me').

INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA.description: Get a published Instagram Media object (photo, video, story, reel, or carousel). Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific Instagram post including engagement metrics, caption, media URLs, and metadata. NOTE: This action is for published media only. For unpublished container IDs (from INSTAGRAM_CREATE_MEDIA_CONTAINER), use INSTAGRAM_GET_POST_STATUS to check status instead.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Supported: id, caption, comments_count, is_comment_enabled, like_count, media_type, media_url, media_product_type, legacy_instagram_media_id, owner, permalink, shortcode, thumbnail_url, timestamp, username, alt_text, is_ai_generated, is_shared_to_feed, media_audio_type, view_count, reposts_count, saved_count, shares_count, total_like_count, total_comments_count, total_views_count, children, comments. For nested fields use 'children{media_url,media_type}'. UNSUPPORTED (cause errors): tagged_users, user_tags, location, filter_name, latitude, longitude, text — use 'caption' not 'text'. For insights metrics use INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA_INSIGHTS. Tagged-media retrieval is unavailable through this Instagram Login toolkit. A MediaBuilder error means the ID is an unpublished container — use INSTAGRAM_GET_POST_STATUS.

ig_media_id.description: The numeric ID of the Instagram media object from the Graph API (e.g., '17858625294504375'). IMPORTANT: This must be a numeric string, NOT an alphanumeric shortcode from instagram.com/p/<shortcode>/ URLs (e.g., 'DUTi4n4D9wg' is NOT valid). Obtain numeric IDs from INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_MEDIA or similar endpoints. For unpublished container IDs, use INSTAGRAM_GET_POST_STATUS instead.
